stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Water and Roads must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Parks and Housing must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Water and Roads must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Parks and Housing must occupy consecutive positions, in either order." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Budget → Parks → Roads → Housing → Water
- Housing → Water → Budget → Parks → Roads
- Housing → Water → Roads → Parks → Budget
- Roads → Parks → Budget → Housing → Water

distractorRationale.a: This is possible, as demonstrated by Budget → Parks → Roads → Housing → Water, which obeys all the original conditions.

distractorRationale.d: This is possible, as demonstrated by Housing → Water → Roads → Parks → Budget, which obeys all the original conditions.
